subject: Insurance
title: Paradise Lost: Camp Fire 2018
description: A quick win: understand Paradise Lost: Camp Fire 2018.

hook.text: The Camp Fire destroyed the town of Paradise in 85 minutes. 18,000 structures gone, 85 dead, $16.5 billion in losses.

buildup.text: PG&E's power lines started the fire. The utility had been warned about maintenance failures for years.

discovery.text: Insurance covered most structural losses, but many residents were underinsured. Rebuilding costs exceeded policy limits.

twist.text: PG&E declared bankruptcy to manage the $30 billion in liabilities. The company that caused the fire couldn't pay for it.

climax.text: Paradise showed that insurance alone can't make people whole when entire communities vanish in minutes.

punchline.text: 85 minutes, 18,000 structures. A whole town erased by one fire.

quiz.question: What started the Camp Fire that destroyed Paradise?
